name: AIZPTToken
fix_description: In sell, ethAmount is calculated using the full sell_amount, but only 50% (swap_amount) is actually transferred to the contract - the other 50% is burned. This means ETH payout is based on 100% but reserves only receive 50% of tokens. Fix: calculate ethAmount based on swap_amount (the portion actually entering the contract), not the full sell_amount.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, direct exploit: take a flash loan, send BNB to the vulnerable token contract, repeatedly transfer the token to itself to trigger the flawed logic, then wrap and repay. It uses only a small number of contracts/calls and does not require deep protocol-specific reasoning beyond spotting the token’s broken transfer/accounting behavior.
